text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up my work and heading to the rooftop,
I ran into Admire Vega and Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, good evening.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...They increased again.
choice_data_list: Good evening. Were you looking at the stars?
Good evening. Were you looking at the stars?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I just happened to bump into Ayabe-senpai here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right.
choice_data_list: The stars are beautiful, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I can see very well today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing up at the stars alongside the two of them,
a quiet moment slowly passes by.
choice_data_list: Ayabe, which star do you like?
Suzuka, which star do you like?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You can probably guess just from my name.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Vega."
A beautiful star that shines with intense brilliance.
choice_data_list: What kind of star is 'Vega' again?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's a star in the Lyra constellation, one of the first-magnitude stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Connect it with Altair and Deneb,
and it forms the 'Summer Triangle.'"
choice_data_list: That must be an amazing star!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it also famous as...
the "Weaver Star" of Tanabata?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When you think of Orihime-sama,
you naturally think of Hikoboshi-sama, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps Ayabe-senpai, too,
will one day meet someone who will be to her
what Hikoboshi is to Orihime."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps, I've already met them...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Someone like that? Not really...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I would have been fine... remaining completely alone forever.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've managed just fine on my own all this time.
I never needed anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still...
ever since coming to this academy,
everyone has been so noisy...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My favorite star?
I suppose it would be... "Spica."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Spica.
What a wonderful, shining blue star."
choice_data_list: What kind of star was "Spica" again?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's a star in the constellation Virgo, one of the first-magnitude stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Connect it with Denebola and Arcturus,
and it forms the 'Spring Triangle.'
choice_data_list: That must be an amazing star!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was...
I just thought 'Suzuka' and 'Spica' sounded kinda similar, so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Half of that was a joke.
It's just... I felt such an overwhelming sense of familiarity.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's not so much the stars I love,
but rather the scenery when I'm alone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My hometown is a place of deep snow...
It was truly overwhelming, how everything
in sight was dyed pure white...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The snow absorbs all sound,
leaving only the beating of my own heart.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All alone in a pure white, silent world.
That is the landscape etched at the origin of my memory.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since coming to this academy,
I haven't had quite as many opportunities to be alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I can tell.
Everyone at this academy
is terribly noisy, after all."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I would have been fine being all alone forever,
yet everyone... so many people
keep crowding around me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I came to this academy,
everyone has been so noisy..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Opera, Doto, and Urara-san...
Top Road-san, Curren-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
All of you, every single one of you...
are so loud...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is that really true?"
...I didn't even need to ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is that really true?"
...I didn't even need to ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to the coldness of her words,
there was a warmth seeping from deep within
her tone of voice.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Neither of us can afford to stay the same, can we?
Ayabe-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...There are so many busybodies at this academy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stars shine.
The sky is clear and wide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as constellations are linked together,
people connect with one another,
weaving their bonds into being.
